title: bankframe
summary: Bank window exists with real BankFrame art regions, the 24 generic slots as icon buttons with quickslot rings, item tooltips, click-to-withdraw, deposit path, bag-slot purchase with BankBagSlotPrice.dbc pricing and locked/open slot art, and delta-based buy-result observation. All 5 wire opcodes hit per the registry.

openItems.text: The six bank-bag popout container windows (Benilla BenillaBankBagFrame1..6, container ids 5..10) do not exist - purchased bank bag slots show ring art only; bags placed there cannot be opened or used
No drag-and-drop cursor flow for bank slots (click withdraws whole item by entry; no place-into-specific-slot, no stack split)
No banker portrait/name title (Benilla binds SetPortraitTexture 'npc' and BANKFRAME_OPENED name)
No player money display on the window (Benilla BenillaBankFrameMoneyCoin1..3), and no purchase confirmation popup (CONFIRM_BUY_BANK_SLOT) - purchase fires immediately
